{
  "candidate_rtl": "module alu_64bit(
    input [63:0] a, b,
    input [2:0] Oper,
    output reg [63:0] sum
);
    wire negate_a = (Oper == 3'b010);
    wire negate_b = (Oper == 3'b001);
    wire subtract = negate_a | negate_b;
    wire [63:0] x = a ^ {64{negate_a}};
    wire [63:0] y = b ^ {64{negate_b}};
    wire [63:0] p = x ^ y;
    wire [63:0] g = x & y;
    wire [63:0] carry;
    wire [63:0] arithmetic_result = p ^ carry;

    // Four-bit groups, followed by a parallel prefix over 16 groups.
    wire [15:0] gp [0:4];
    wire [15:0] gg [0:4];
    wire [15:0] block_carry;

    genvar j, level, k;
    generate
        for (j = 0; j < 16; j = j + 1) begin : make_groups
            assign gp[0][j] = &p[4*j +: 4];
            assign gg[0][j] = g[4*j+3]
                | (p[4*j+3] & g[4*j+2])
                | (p[4*j+3] & p[4*j+2] & g[4*j+1])
                | (p[4*j+3] & p[4*j+2] & p[4*j+1] & g[4*j]);
        end
        for (level = 0; level < 4; level = level + 1) begin : prefix_levels
            for (k = 0; k < 16; k = k + 1) begin : prefix_nodes
                if (k >= (1 << level)) begin : combine
                    assign gp[level+1][k] = gp[level][k]
                        & gp[level][k-(1 << level)];
                    assign gg[level+1][k] = gg[level][k]
                        | (gp[level][k] & gg[level][k-(1 << level)]);
                end else begin : pass_through
                    assign gp[level+1][k] = gp[level][k];
                    assign gg[level+1][k] = gg[level][k];
                end
            end
        end
    endgenerate

    assign block_carry[0] = subtract;
    generate
        for (j = 1; j < 16; j = j + 1) begin : block_inputs
            assign block_carry[j] = gg[4][j-1]
                | (gp[4][j-1] & subtract);
        end
        for (j = 0; j < 16; j = j + 1) begin : local_carries
            assign carry[4*j] = block_carry[j];
            assign carry[4*j+1] = g[4*j]
                | (p[4*j] & block_carry[j]);
            assign carry[4*j+2] = g[4*j+1]
                | (p[4*j+1] & g[4*j])
                | (p[4*j+1] & p[4*j] & block_carry[j]);
            assign carry[4*j+3] = g[4*j+2]
                | (p[4*j+2] & g[4*j+1])
                | (p[4*j+2] & p[4*j+1] & g[4*j])
                | (p[4*j+2] & p[4*j+1] & p[4*j] & block_carry[j]);
        end
    endgenerate

    always @(*) begin
        case (Oper)
            3'b000: sum = arithmetic_result;
            3'b001: sum = arithmetic_result;
            3'b010: sum = arithmetic_result;
            3'b011: sum = a | b;
            3'b100: sum = a & b;
            3'b101: sum = a ^ b;
            3'b110: sum = a ~^ b;
            default: sum = 64'b0;
        endcase
    end
endmodule",
  "bottleneck": {
    "suspected": "Long-distance arithmetic carry computation followed by result selection, with buffering and fanout also contributing.",
    "evidence": "The measured worst paths propagate from a[5] to sum[54], sum[55], and sum[47], share a substantial mapped-cell prefix, and traverse many NAND/NOR and AOI/OAI stages. The sum[54] path includes a late XOR followed by two selection-compatible complex gates. The conservative pre-ABC cone contains addition, both subtraction operators, and a result pmux.",
    "limits": "This supports targeting the arithmetic/result-selection cone, but does not establish which arithmetic operation is critical, identify exact carry cells, or demonstrate serial mapped adders. The supplied localization is explicitly not an exact standard-cell-to-RTL mapping."
  },
  "rewrite": {
    "description": "Share one arithmetic datapath across all three arithmetic operations. Implement its carry network explicitly using four-bit group generate/propagate terms, a four-level parallel prefix across sixteen groups, and local lookahead within each group. Keep the bitwise operations and complete output case selection.",
    "arithmetic_identity": "The shared datapath computes (a XOR negate_a_mask) + (b XOR negate_b_mask) + subtract. For addition neither operand is inverted; a-b inverts b and adds one; b-a inverts a and adds one.",
    "intent": "Expose bounded-depth carry computation while avoiding three independently expressed wide arithmetic operators. ABC may still restructure the network; the RTL topology is not a guarantee of the mapped topology."
  },
  "expected_timing_gain": {
    "status": "Unmeasured hypothesis; no candidate EDA results are available.",
    "hypothesis": "An exploratory target is approximately 5–15% lower maximum data arrival than 3.05 ns, roughly 2.59–2.90 ns. This is not a predicted or certified result.",
    "risks": "Operand-conditioning XORs, operation-control fanout, prefix fanout, output selection, and ABC restructuring can erase the benefit or make the candidate slower. Compare maximum data arrival directly, not the large virtual-clock slack."
  },

    "tradeoff": "Arithmetic sharing is intended to offset the explicit prefix network and operand conditioning. Prefix wiring has no physical parasitic cost in the specified experiment, but its electrical fanout can require buffers and larger cells. Neither area compliance nor electrical eligibility follows from source-level operator counts.",
    "required_validation": "Run full functional equivalence and the exact supplied Yosys/ABC/OpenSTA flow. Accept only if mapped area is at most the cap, max-slew and max-capacitance violations are both zero, and maximum data arrival improves on 3.05 ns. No such passes are claimed here."
  },
  "functional_boundaries": {
    "interface": "Preserves module alu_64bit, inputs a[63:0], b[63:0], Oper[2:0], and output reg sum[63:0].",
    "operations": "000: a+b; 001: a-b; 010: b-a; 011: OR; 100: AND; 101: XOR; 110: XNOR; 111: zero.",
    "arithmetic": "All arithmetic results wrap modulo 2^64. The unused internal carry output is not retained because it is not an observable port.",
    "restrictions": "Purely combinational, with complete assignments. No clocks, state, assumptions, input restrictions, or don't-cares are introduced."
  }
}
